resources.string: Choose a folder to enable automatic backups
Backup failed. Check folder access and free space.
The first backup will be saved after you choose a folder. Then every 14 days, when Android allows background work. Previous files are kept.
Downloads → Trace → Backup is created automatically with the first backup. Then a copy is saved every 14 days. Previous files are kept.
On Android 8–9, choose a folder once. Backups are then saved automatically.
